items.label: Multi-Functional Design
items.value: This versatile folding sofa bed easily transforms between a sofa bed, long sofa, and folding sofa, adapting to your every need. Whether entertaining, working, or relaxing, it perfectly delivers comfort and convenience to your daily life

items.label: Space-Saving Solution
items.value: The compact and foldable design fits seamlessly in small spaces, which is tailored for studio apartments, dorms and tiny homes.Folding sofa bed chair maximizes the utilization of every space, say goodbye to clutter

items.label: Headrest and Lumbar Pillow
items.value: Features ergonomic foam padding and soft breathable fabric, you won't feel tired after sitting for a long time. The detachable back and lumbar pillows with secure snap buttons provide optimal support, creating a comfortable chair bed configuration when needed

items.label: Easy Setup & Portability
items.value: Ready to use right out of the box—just unfold and let foldable couch bed expand within 24-48H. Gently patting the surface helps accelerate its recovery to full shape. Lightweight at 29.54 lbs with a compact 33.46"×33.46"×22" design for easy moving, effortlessly settling into small spaces

items.label: Contemporary Style Options
items.value: This convertible folding sofa bed features a sleek design with clean lines and stylish stitching. Multiple color choices to match any decor while adding modern elegance
